mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_activity (user_id, course_id, chapter_id, action) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{chapterId}, #{action})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.course_id, a.chapter_id, a.action, a.created_at, c.title AS course_title, ch.title AS chapter_title FROM user_activity a LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.id = a.course_id LEFT JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = a.chapter_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
